objective.name: sandbox.dsl.meaning.to.matter.chain
objective.description: Read local meaning, materialize part of it into a matter revision, read that matter back, and terminate through a wrapper.

#root.role: Use local read.meaning as the source of one matter.write, then read that matter back and pass the committed fields to a local wrapper consumer.

effects.meaning_driven_write: A local meaning descriptor value is materialized into a matter revision.
effects.matter_readback: The newly written matter is read back before wrapper termination.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one terminal wrapper response after a local meaning descriptor is materialized into a matter revision and read back.
invariants: The local matter write uses objective.name as functional.message and objective.description as functional.source_ctx.
The terminal wrapper consumes the committed matter values returned by matter.read, not the pre-commit meaning alias directly.
success: The terminal payload exposes summary and ctx_id from sandbox.consume.record.
The committed local matter revision stores sandbox.echo as functional.message and the objective description as functional.source_ctx.
failure: The flow fails if read.meaning, matter.write, or matter.read cannot complete before terminal consumption.
The flow fails if the local matter cannot be updated with the meaning-derived fields.
notes: This scenario validates that meaning can be materialized into matter and then consumed through a later committed read.
The matter side effect is part of the scenario and is verified directly by the N7 harness.
